note: Chat & Tool Calls.dc.html's Focus / Web search walkthrough state compared with the actual shared TcChat tool card and Run-cockpit AgentsTab. The local design is the visual source of truth. Selector correspondence is intentionally explicit: a live tool card is not a design mock clone. The reference's synthetic Orchestrator row is the one documented product divergence: the runtime sends a supervisor-role alias on a child but no parent task, and Focus intentionally does not invent one.

expectDivergence.margin: The reference indents the agent below its synthetic Orchestrator. Live correctly keeps it at depth zero until the runtime emits a concrete parent task.
